SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - JUNE 22, 2015 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
JUNE 22, 2015 IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Pastor Alex Kim, First Evangelical Church of Cerritos.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Boy Scout Pack #75.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair George Ray
  Mayor/Chair Carol Chen

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Rishi Ravichandran (Eagle Scout)

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Victor Manalo, Gateway Cities Council of Governments representative, provided an
  update report on the organization’s projects and programs.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one
  motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency
  Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the
  Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated June 22, 2015
  (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated June 22, 2015 in the total amount of
  $2,849,137.83 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  June 22, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 7

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency dated
  June 22, 2015 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the Successor Agency dated June 22, 2015 in the total amount of
  $14,815,000.00 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  June 11, 2015 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of June 11, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Review and consideration of award of contract for Mechanical Equipment Maintenance
  Services, Bid No. 1209-15 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Award a contract for mechanical equipment maintenance services, Bid No. 1209-15
  to the apparent low bidders, F.M. Thomas Air Conditioning, Inc., in the amount of
  $52,668.00, and reject all other bids received, and
  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any change orders related to
  this maintenance work. The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A JOINT RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO
  THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY, APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE ANNUAL
  BUDGET FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2015-2016, APPROPRIATING THE FUNDS NECESSARY
  TO MEET THE EXPENDITURES SET FORTH THEREIN, AND APPROVING THE
  INVESTMENT POLICY FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2015-2016 FOR THE CITY OF CERRITOS
  AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Budget Manager.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.
 City of Cerritos  June 22, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 7

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8A.  (continued)

  Ram Kakkar suggested placing copies of the budget in the Cerritos Library for
  reference.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments and the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Pulido, to add the community
  calendar at a cost not to exceed $50,000.00 to the consideration of the 2015-2016
  Annual Budget (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (3 – 2) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki
  NOES:  Ray, Chen
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

  MOTION: It was moved by, and seconded by, to:

  1. Receive and file the Planning Commission resolution finding the Capital Improvement
  Plan for Fiscal Year 2015-2016 in conformance with the General Plan for the City of
  Cerritos, and
  2. Include the community calendar at a cost not to exceed $50,000.00 to the 2015-
  2016 Annual Budget, and
  3. Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2015-17, A JOINT RESOLUTION
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE SUCCESSOR
  AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY, APPROVING AND
  ADOPTING THE ANNUAL BUDGET FOR THE FISCAL YEAR 2015-2016,
  APPROPRIATING THE FUNDS NECESSARY TO MEET THE EXPENDITURES
  SET FORTH THEREIN, AND APPROVING THE INVESTMENT POLICY FOR
  THE FISCAL YEAR 2015-2016 FOR THE CITY OF CERRITOS AND THE
  SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY), subject to the following amendments:

  WHEREAS, the City Manager of the City of Cerritos, in accordance with Article IX
  of the Municipal Charter, has submitted to the City Council of the City of Cerritos a
  2015-2016 Fiscal Year combined Operating and Capital Improvement Budget in
  the amount of $92,873,792 $92,923,792 in proposed expenditures for general
  and special City purposes and reflecting funds available in the total amount of
  $91,249,565; and

  SECTION 1. The City Manager's proposed 2015-2016 Fiscal Year Budget for
  general and special City purposes, is approved and adopted in the amount of
  $92,873,792 $92,923,792 for expenditures and $91,249,565 in revenue. The
  referenced approved expenditure amount is inclusive of a request authorized by
  the City Council at the June 22, 2015 City Council meeting to include an allocation
  not to exceed $50,000 for the production and distribution of the 2016 Community
  Calendar.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  June 22, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 7

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of adoption of the Fiscal Year 2015-2016 appropriation limit
  (COUNCIL).

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE ANNUAL
  APPROPRIATION LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015-2016 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Budget Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Solanki, to waive full reading of and
  adopt Resolution No. 2015-18, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING AND ADOPTING THE ANNUAL
  APPROPRIATION LIMIT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2015-2016. The motion carried (5 –
  0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9B.  Review and consideration of artwork by Cliff Garten Studio submitted by Macerich
  Cerritos, LLC for Los Cerritos Center, in accordance with Chapter 22.94 of the Cerritos
  Municipal Code as it relates to the Art in Public Places Program. The project is located
  in the Los Cerritos Center, generally located at 239 Los Cerritos Mall (APN’s 7038-
  014-017 and 7038-014-022) (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kathy Matsumoto, Assistant City Manager. A PowerPoint
  Presentation was displayed.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Andy Greenwood, representing Macerich Cerritos, LLC, spoke regarding the placement of
  the proposed art piece on the subject property.

  Ram Kakkar made suggestions regarding the placement of the art.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public
  comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to approve the subject
  art piece “Quadras” by applicant Macerich Cerritos, LLC, for the major renovation project
  at the Los Cerritos Center (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  June 22, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9C.  Review and consideration of a cost sharing agreement for the installation of
  monitoring equipment and monitoring pursuant to the Harbor Toxic Pollutants
  Total Maximum Daily Load (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Environmental Services Manager.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Solanki, to approve and authorize
  the City Manager to execute the agreement between the City of Cerritos and the
  Gateway Water Management Authority for the installation of monitoring equipment
  and monitoring pursuant to the Harbor Toxic Pollutants Total Maximum Daily Load
  (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9D.  Review and consideration of activities in celebration of the City Of Cerritos' 60th
  Anniversary (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Sherré Titus, Recreation Services Superintendent.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Ram Kakkar expressed concerns with expenditures related to a parade for the 60th
  Anniversary.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Ray, to approve an enhanced
  Community Spring Festival in celebration of the City’s 60th Anniversary, in an amount
  not to exceed $60,000.00 (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9E.  Review and consideration of amendments to the contracts with MCM Management
  Company and VA Consulting for costs associated with the design and construction
  administration for the expansion of the Cerritos Recycled Water System to serve
  Forest Lawn Memorial Park in the City of Cypress; and authorization for the City
  Manager to execute an associated maintenance agreement with the City of
  Cypress (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given Kanna Vancheswaran, Assistant City Engineer.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.
 City of Cerritos  June 22, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 6 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9E.  (continued)

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Approve and authorize the City Manager to execute the Maintenance Agreement
  with the City of Cypress outlining the terms and conditions related to the
  maintenance of the water line and related infrastructure, subject to final approval
  by the City Attorney, and
  2. Approve and authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute the
  amendment to the agreement with MCM Management Company in the amount of
  $48,600 under Project No. 17198 and authorize the City Manager or his designee
  to execute any additional project-related contract amendments, and
  3. Approve and authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute the
  amendment to the agreement with VA Consulting in the amount of $35,333.00,
  under Project No. 17198 and authorize the City Manager or his designee to
  execute any additional project-related contract amendments (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9F.  Review and Consideration of proposals received for Citywide Water Feature
  Maintenance and Repair for the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Hal Arbogast, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Edwards, to reject all proposals
  received and grant permission to re-advertise for Citywide Water Feature
  Maintenance and Repair for the City of Cerritos (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State or
  Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.
 City of Cerritos  June 22, 2015
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 7 of 7

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Pulido, Solanki, and Edwards, Mayor
  Pro Tem Ray, and Mayor Chen.

12.  Closed Session

  None.

13.  Adjournment
  The meeting was adjourned at 9:06 p.m.
